behavior: An invoice can carry the price agreed with the client in fiat (currency, amount and date), shown on the form, the invoice and pay pages and the PDFs (PLAN 10.2)
acceptance: The create request takes an optional agreedValue {currency, amount, date}: the price agreed with the client in fiat. currency is EUR or one of the currencies the ECB publishes a daily rate for (D-82); amount is above 0 with at most that currency's ISO 4217 decimals; date is YYYY-MM-DD. A broken rule is 422 invalid_value. It is stored in the currency's minor units, never changes, is part of the idempotency hash only when set, and comes back as agreedValue {currency, amount (minor units), decimals, date} or null on the owner's and the public reads.

New invoice can add an agreed value in the Amount panel (not on Request money); the owner's invoice page and the pay page show it, and the invoice, canceled invoice and receipt PDFs print it under the total; Duplicate copies it, the rest of a closed invoice does not.
The web's currency list matches the API's (a Go test reads it); axe 0 and no sideways scroll at 390 px.
